notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37486819/ade516080069ae16a07f7edd6c11ebf32bc79309.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our [b]sixth patch notes post[/b]! Our goal is to effectively relay the updated information to the community. As we are currently in the pre-alpha development stage.

The majority of you will not have access to the present built, but, we are collaborating with a select group of streamers and playtesters who are helping us to stress test on a semi-regular basis. 

These patch notes serve two purposes. Firstly, as an archival element, to easily go back and see which issues were addressed, and when. Secondly, to show the community that we are busy working on Cold Comfort, trying to make it a great experience for you.

Oh wait, there’s a third point, as this is new territory for us, especially in this early stage of development, your opinion regarding the format and information on how these updates are conveyed is important. As always, feel free to hop onto our [url=https://discord.gg/coldcomfort]discord community[/url] channel and let us know what you think!

Interested in participating in our next stress test? Fill out the appropriate form in triplicate, making sure to include your blood type and Gamma Strain vaccination status. OR simply reach out to one of the community managers on our [url=https://discord.gg/coldcomfort]discord[/url].


Our full update notes are below.

[h2]WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 0.0.6?[/h2]
February 27th, 2021

[h3]NEW[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented proper marker creation for survivor players
[*] Added proper screen shakes for SKL9 Pistol and AK
[*] Added heat vision for rat players which can be used with the vision item key (Default = L)
[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Recalibrated muzzle flashes (SKL9 Pistol, AK, and Thumper)
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] removing faulty ping displayed in the server browser
[*] Fixed areas where players fell through the map
[*] Fixed Steam profile icons not shown in player selection (experimental)
[*] Minor UI Fixes and previous placeholder implementations
[*] Fixed long nickname overflow in the preparation phase of the game
[*] Fixed marker logic when stuck at the screen corner
[/list]

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s still possible to push the AI around which is probably caused by collision profiles not properly updating
[*] Arachna cannot continue crawling over the lip of the building wall
[*] Weapon handling is not optimized
[*] Cursor lock using weapons can bug out sometimes
[*] Performance is not optimized
[/list]

[h2]WHERE THE HECK ARE PATCH NOTES 0.0.5?[/h2]
Yeah, we flubbed that one- please accept our humble apology. Yeah, but no, seriously, we pushed a new build right before a live stream and the fixes were minor. Essentially we had a game-breaking crash hotfix, and need a different version number to ascertain that everyone was on the same build. There, we told ya. Happy now?

[h2][b]WISHLIST[/b][/h2]
Interested in staying informed about updates regarding Cold Comfort? Just curious? Fear no more! Now you can simply wishlist the game and be in the know. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/683190/Cold_Comfort/

[h2][b]QUESTIONNAIRE[/b][/h2]
As game developers, we sometimes suffer from tunnel vision, and forget what is truly important to you, our fans!  By filling out [url=https://goo.gl/forms/gWOgIs3vGVV5yDof1]this questionnaire[/url], we'll get a better grasp of what you guys and gals expect and want out of Cold Comfort, and how we can give you the most excellent gaming experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37486819/3d67ae6831608ad851beac5a7f6e73063506380f.gif[/img]

Our [url=https://discord.gg/coldcomfort]discord server[/url] is alive! You can join the conversation and hang out with other fans on the discord server and talk directly to us regarding your thoughts and ideas about [b]Cold Comfort[/b].

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.0.4
notes.content:
Welcome to our [b]fourth patch notes post[/b]! Our goal is to effectively relay the updated information to the community. As we are currently in the pre-alpha development stage, the majority of you will not have access to the present built, but, we are collaborating with a select group of streamers and playtesters who are helping us to stress test on a semi-regular basis. 

These patch notes serve two purposes. Firstly, as an archival element, to easily go back and see which issues were addressed, and when. Secondly, to show the community that we are busy working on Cold Comfort, trying to make it a great experience for you.

Oh wait, there’s a third point, as this is new territory for us, especially in this early stage of development, your opinion regarding the format and information on how these updates are conveyed is important. As always, feel free to hop onto our [url=https://discord.gg/coldcomfort]discord community[/url] channel and let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=R5opcYb_JZQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Our full update notes are below.

[h2]WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 0.0.4?[/h2]

December 22nd, 2020

[h3]NEW[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased match size from 2v2 to 5v5
[*] Increased Civilian pool from 50 to 125
[*] Increase Corpse pool from 50 to 125
[*] Increased number of required Civilians to evacuate from 10 to 20
[*] Added a 3rd Extraction point
[*] Increased map size (Seneca City) by 4 fold
[*] Added minimap/radar
[*] Added map markers for extraction points
[*] Added experimental map markers for resources (ammo, medical, fuses)
[*] Added flashlight functionality for Survivors (L)
[*] Implemented actual functionality for the top team bar which displays the character icons now
[*] Added scaffolding to map, to allow rooftop access
[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved previous extraction point locations for optimal distancing
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Collision bug with scaffolding 
[*] Fixed areas where players fell through the map
[*] Fixed Zombie attacking behavior Corpse Position is now synced between Server and Client (except when ragdolling)
[*] Fixed AI walking through each other
[*] Minor UI Fixes and previous placeholder implementations
[*] Fixed Steam Icons not showing during character selection
[*] Fixed marker logic when stuck at screen corner
[/list]

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s still possible to push the AI around which is probably caused by collision profiles not properly updating
[*] Arachna cannot continue crawling over the lip of the building wall
[*] Weapon handling is not optimized
[*] Cursor lock using weapons can bug out sometimes
[*] Performance is not optimized
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE #001 - OUR STEAM PAGE IS LIVE
notes.content:
After much deliberation, we decided the best course of action was to create a steam page- and we couldn't be happier with the feedback and resonance that we've received so far.

Our goal is that by doing so at this stage of development, we can help build awareness, and generate excitement among fans. We plan on pumping out regular updates, keeping you informed about our process, trials, and tribulations. 

[h2]WISHLIST[/h2]
Not gonna lie here, the whole wishlist option was one of the biggest motivational factors in our decision to go live with our steam page. Adding Cold Comfort to your wishlist is a great way to support the development and stay up to date.  As we are a small indie dev studio among many, garnering the attention of not only potential fans, but also potential publishers is of paramount importance.  Is Cold Comfort going to be successful? Who the heck knows! All we can say is that we are confident that with the proper support, we strive to make Cold Comfort a contender. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37486819/2b7d86ffd34f021e7c3d1c78f8ebaef6c750fc9c.gif[/img]

[/list]

We are currently working on a number of other language versions as well! We want as many potential fans of [b]Cold Comfort [/b]to be able to get hyped about the game as possible. 

[h2]MODULARITY IN THE PIPE[/h2]
An elaborate and customized AI system is a key feature for a multiplayer game that utilizes NPCs. The better the AI system is planned and executed, the better optimization of resources will be in the game. Furthermore, it affects the visuals and the experienced realism, as well as the entire gameplay experience.

The Modular AI in Cold Comfort plays a big role in maintaining realism and authenticity in a visceral environment. One key feature, and also aim, of the Modular AI system, is being resource-efficient. The Modular AI System aims at delivering a certain level of randomness in the appearance of NPCs by combining interchangeable body/clothing parts and altering the texture (adding dirt, blood, etc.) with the help of masks and nodes, and can be sustained with a smaller, and thus more resource-efficient library, rather than using a big library filled with different NPCs and texture sets. But in order to make the system work flawlessly, there are important aspects in the creation process that need to be taken care of.
